format: JavaScript with React and Jest testing framework
description: This file contains test cases for the RubiksCube React component, the RubiksCubeLogic class, and the CubeNotation parsing/validation functions. It uses @testing-library/react for component testing and mocks Three.js for 3D rendering dependencies.

classes.name: RubiksCubeLogic
classes.description: Class managing the logic and state of a Rubik's cube, including move execution, undo/redo, reset, scramble, and resizing.

methods.name: executeMove
methods.description: Executes a move on the cube, updating the move history.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Redoes a move that was previously undone.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the cube to its initial state, clearing move history.

methods.name: scramble
methods.description: Randomly generates a sequence of moves to scramble the cube.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Changes the size of the cube and recalculates the cubelets.
